marks.label: Username or email
marks.text: Type your username (for example, cashier) or your email address.

marks.label: Password
marks.text: Type your password. The eye button shows what you typed.

marks.label: Sign in
marks.text: Click Sign in. Five wrong attempts lock sign-in for 15 minutes.

marks.text: Post a loan payment, post a deposit or withdrawal, register a member, open reports.

marks.text: Search any member from any page (Ctrl+K or /).

marks.text: Opens the registration form (Cashier and Manager).

marks.label: Personal details
marks.text: Name, birthdate, civil status, address, mobile number, and email. Fields with * are required.

marks.label: TIN (required)
marks.text: FFMPC requires the TIN for membership.

marks.label: PMES date
marks.text: Date the applicant attended the pre-membership seminar.

marks.label: Signature card
marks.text: Tick when the signature specimen card is received.

marks.label: Member type
marks.text: Members from outside the school must give collateral for loans.

marks.label: Register member
marks.text: Saves the applicant; the member number and the Share Capital and Regular Savings accounts are created.

marks.label: Requirements checklist
marks.text: Green is done, red is still missing. Here the fee and the share capital are missing.

marks.label: Receive membership fee
marks.text: The fee is fixed (₱250, set in Settings). One click records it and opens the receipt.

marks.label: Status: Applicant
marks.text: Stays an Applicant until the Manager approves.

marks.label: Record tabs
marks.text: Eligibility, profile, accounts, loans, and payment history.

marks.text: The next number in the official receipt series.

marks.text: Returns to the member record.

marks.text: The member's savings and share capital accounts.

marks.label: Open another account
marks.text: Adds a Capital Build-Up or Time Deposit account.

marks.label: Open passbook
marks.text: Opens the passbook, where transactions are posted.

marks.label: Deposit or withdraw
marks.text: Deposit is selected. A share capital withdrawal needs a BOD resolution.

marks.label: Amount and date
marks.text: Enter ₱2,000 for the initial share capital; the date defaults to today.

marks.label: Post and issue receipt
marks.text: Saves the deposit, updates the balance, and issues an OR.

marks.label: Current balance
marks.text: The balance before this transaction, with the rules of the account.

marks.label: OR number
marks.text: Every deposit and withdrawal gets its own receipt number.

marks.label: Amount
marks.text: The amount deposited or withdrawn.

marks.label: Balance after
marks.text: The running balance written to the passbook.

marks.label: Print
marks.text: Thermal 80mm or full report layout.

marks.label: Totals per account type
marks.text: Click a tile to list only that type.

marks.label: Passbook / Post
marks.text: Open the passbook, or post a deposit or withdrawal directly.

marks.label: Open an account
marks.text: Choose the account type and click Open account. One account of each type per member.

marks.label: Export or print
marks.text: Copy, CSV, Excel, or Print.

marks.label: Withdraw
marks.text: Choose Withdraw and enter the amount (₱700 here).

marks.label: Passbook presented
marks.text: Required for every withdrawal.

marks.label: Withdrawable now
marks.text: The most that can be withdrawn while keeping the maintaining balance.

marks.label: Refused
marks.text: ₱700 would go below the ₱500 maintaining balance, so the system refuses it and says how much is allowed.

marks.label: Receipt number
marks.text: Each line carries its own OR number; interest lines have none.

marks.label: Running balance
marks.text: The balance after each transaction.

marks.label: Post transaction
marks.text: Opens the deposit or withdrawal form.

marks.label: Print
marks.text: Prints the passbook ledger.

marks.label: Applicants filter
marks.text: Shows everyone waiting for approval.

marks.label: Status: Applicant
marks.text: Changes to Active after approval.

marks.label: Actions
marks.text: Eye: open the record, where the Manager approves. Pen: edit the profile. Red button: deactivate (members are never deleted; refused while a loan is pending or running).

marks.label: All requirements met
marks.text: PMES, signature card, TIN, membership fee, and ₱2,000 share capital are all green.

marks.label: Approve membership
marks.text: Enabled only when every requirement is met.

marks.label: Status: Active
marks.text: The member can now apply for loans.

marks.label: Record tabs
marks.text: Eligibility, profile, accounts, loans, and payment history.

marks.label: Eligibility summary
marks.text: Checked before every loan: membership, payment record, co-maker, collateral, existing loans, share capital.

marks.label: Edit profile
marks.text: Manager, Cashier, and Loan Officer can correct the profile.

marks.text: Only the modules a Loan Officer may use.

marks.label: Today at a glance
marks.text: Applications in process, past-due loans, and dues in 7 days come first.

marks.label: Delinquency summary
marks.text: Accounts and amount past due, with the worst accounts listed.

marks.label: Quick actions
marks.text: New loan application, update the delinquency list, open reports.

marks.label: Find the member
marks.text: Type a last name, first name, or member number.

marks.label: Pick the member
marks.text: Only active members can borrow; applicants must be approved first.

marks.label: Loan product
marks.text: Regular, Salary, or Emergency Loan. The allowed range is shown below the field.

marks.label: Principal and term
marks.text: The amount and the number of months.

marks.label: Co-maker
marks.text: Required for every loan; must be an active FFMPC member, picked from the list.

marks.label: Collateral
marks.text: Required for a Regular Loan and for members outside the school; loanable up to 30% of the appraised value.

marks.label: Net pay and how to pay
marks.text: Net pay is for a Salary Loan: the monthly amortization must not exceed it.

marks.label: Eligibility summary
marks.text: Shown beside the form while you encode.

marks.label: Submit application
marks.text: Records the application as Pending.

marks.label: Same principal
marks.text: An equal slice of principal every month.

marks.label: Interest
marks.text: 3% of the remaining balance, so it goes down every month.

marks.label: Total due
marks.text: Principal plus interest.

marks.label: Semi-monthly
marks.text: Half the monthly amount, for salary deductions on the 15th and 30th.

marks.label: Totals
marks.text: Total interest and total payable over the term.

marks.label: Status and progress
marks.text: Applied → Approved → Released → Fully paid.

marks.label: Eligibility summary
marks.text: Information for the credit committee; the system does not decide.

marks.label: Details
marks.text: Co-maker, collateral, and how the member will pay.

marks.label: Edit
marks.text: A pending application can still be corrected.

marks.label: Cancel application
marks.text: For example when the member withdraws it; a reason is asked.

marks.label: Your menu
marks.text: The sidebar lists only the modules your role may use. The Manager sees all of them.

marks.label: Today at a glance
marks.text: Applications in process, loans awaiting release, past-due loans, portfolio, collections, members, share capital, and savings.

marks.label: Approvals & releases queue
marks.text: Pending and approved loans waiting for the Manager.

marks.label: Quick actions
marks.text: Shortcuts to the tasks of the signed-in role.

marks.label: Recent activity
marks.text: Latest entries from the audit log.

marks.label: Eligibility summary
marks.text: What the credit committee looked at.

marks.label: Committee note
marks.text: Optional note from the credit committee meeting.

marks.label: Approve
marks.text: Records the Manager's approval. Whoever encoded the application cannot decide it.

marks.label: Reject
marks.text: Records a rejection instead; a reason is required.

marks.label: Release date
marks.text: The date the proceeds are released.

marks.label: Cash or check
marks.text: A check needs its check number.

marks.label: Deductions and net proceeds
marks.text: Insurance 0.56%, service fee 3%, stockshare 2%, notarial ₱200, printing ₱30. Interest is not deducted in advance.

marks.label: Release
marks.text: Releases the loan and generates the amortization schedule.

marks.label: Schedule
marks.text: Opens the printable schedule.

marks.label: Outstanding principal
marks.text: Goes down as payments are posted.

marks.label: Installment status
marks.text: Paid, Partial, or Unpaid for each month.

marks.label: Currently due
marks.text: The installment due next, what is due now, and the full payoff amount.

marks.label: Details
marks.text: Who applied, approved, and released, with the deductions at release.

marks.label: Print
marks.text: Prints the member's copy.

marks.label: Borrower and loan
marks.text: Borrower, co-maker, collateral, principal, term, and rate.

marks.label: Semi-monthly column
marks.text: The amount for each payroll cut-off.

marks.label: Deductions
marks.text: Deductions at release and the net proceeds.

marks.label: After-term rule
marks.text: 3% interest plus 4% penalty per month, computed per day, on the balance + unpaid interest once the term ends.

marks.label: Signatures
marks.text: The borrower and the authorized officer sign here.

marks.label: Add product
marks.text: Create a new loan product.

marks.label: Product card
marks.text: Rate, loanable basis, limits, and term.

marks.label: Edit
marks.text: Changes apply to future applications.

marks.label: Deactivate
marks.text: Hides the product from new applications; existing loans keep their terms.

marks.label: Product name
marks.text: Shown in the application form and the products page.

marks.label: Amount limits
marks.text: The minimum and maximum principal the product allows.

marks.label: Term and rates
marks.text: Months, the monthly interest (3% diminishing), and the after-term penalty (4%).

marks.label: Loanable basis
marks.text: Appraised value (30%), monthly net pay, or a fixed amount.

marks.label: Save product
marks.text: New settings affect only future applications.

marks.label: Deduction rates
marks.text: Insurance, service fee, stockshare, notarial, and printing fees taken at release.

marks.label: Loanable amount
marks.text: Share of the collateral's appraised value that can be borrowed (30%).

marks.label: Account minimums
marks.text: Share capital, maintaining balance, time deposit, and CBU.

marks.label: Fees and interest
marks.text: The fixed membership fee and the savings interest rate.

marks.label: Monitoring
marks.text: Days before due for reminders, and the aging brackets.

marks.label: OR series
marks.text: Set the last number issued to match the booklet; it can only move forward.

marks.label: Verb labels
marks.text: Language of the action words on buttons (for example Post, Void).

marks.label: Save settings
marks.text: Only the Manager can change settings; other roles see them read-only.

marks.label: Sample check
marks.text: Recomputes FFMPC's ₱26,000 sample with the current rates.

marks.label: How it works
marks.text: The scheduled task sends the pending reminders through this account.

marks.label: SMTP host and port
marks.text: smtp.gmail.com on 587 (STARTTLS) or 465 (SSL).

marks.label: Username and app password
marks.text: A Gmail App Password (16 letters), never the sign-in password. Saved masked.

marks.label: From address
marks.text: The cooperative's email address shown to members.

marks.label: Save email settings
marks.text: Manager only.

marks.label: Add user
marks.text: Create a staff account and choose its role.

marks.label: Role
marks.text: Decides what each person may do.

marks.label: Edit
marks.text: Change the name, role, or status, or reset the password.

marks.label: Deactivate
marks.text: Accounts are deactivated, never deleted.

marks.label: Name, username, email
marks.text: The username or the email is used to sign in.

marks.label: Role
marks.text: Manager, Cashier, Loan Officer, Bookkeeper, or Board / Auditor.

marks.label: Password
marks.text: The first password; the user changes it after signing in.

marks.label: What each role can do
marks.text: A reminder of the duties of each role.

marks.label: Create account
marks.text: Saves the new staff account.

marks.label: Zero balance
marks.text: An account can be closed only at ₱0.00.

marks.label: Close account
marks.text: Manager only. The passbook history is kept, and the account can be reopened later.

marks.label: Result
marks.text: Green when every stored balance matches its ledger.

marks.label: Loans check
marks.text: For every released loan: the unpaid schedule total must equal the stored outstanding balance.

marks.label: Savings check
marks.text: For every account: the sum of its transactions (reversals applied) must equal the stored balance.

marks.label: Find the member

marks.text: Click the member in the list.

marks.text: Search again to change the member.

marks.text: Click the loan being paid; the next due date and balance are shown.

marks.label: Amount received
marks.text: ₱12,000 here, which is more than one installment.

marks.label: Mode of payment
marks.text: Cash, salary deduction, or another mode.

marks.text: Penalty → interest → principal. The installments covered are listed.

marks.text: Saves the payment and opens the receipt.

marks.text: What is due today, and the amount that closes the loan (no rebate).

marks.text: One receipt for the whole payment.

marks.label: Installments covered
marks.text: Every installment this payment settled.

marks.label: Total paid
marks.text: Split into interest and principal just above.

marks.label: Remaining balance
marks.text: Outstanding principal after this payment.

marks.label: Print
marks.text: Thermal 80mm or full report layout.

marks.label: Term ended
marks.text: The loan term has ended; charges now accrue per day.

marks.text: Unpaid balance + unpaid interest is charged 3% interest + 4% penalty per month, computed per day, collected first.

marks.label: Due now
marks.text: The total including the after-term charges.

marks.label: Payment received on
marks.text: Recompute when the payment was received on an earlier date.

marks.text: Opens the password page.

marks.label: Log out
marks.text: Always log out before leaving the computer.

marks.text: Proves it is you before the password can change.

marks.text: At least 8 characters with letters and numbers, typed twice.

marks.text: Loans and amounts per bracket: 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 91–180, 181–365, over 365 days.

marks.text: Prints a letter for the borrower, with a copy for the co-maker.

marks.text: Listed with their due dates, plus the after-term interest and penalty.

marks.text: The co-maker gets a copy and is liable.

marks.text: Signed for the cooperative; the borrower signs on receipt.

marks.text: Creates messages for dues within 3 days and for overdue loans.

marks.text: Filter the reminders by status.

marks.text: The text that will be sent to the member.

marks.text: Pending reminders with an email address are sent by the scheduled task.

marks.text: Loans and balances per product and status.

marks.text: For example 2027-Q1. Accounts already posted for the label are skipped.

marks.text: Credits 1% of the balance to every active regular savings account in one run.

marks.label: Time deposits
marks.text: 1% per term, posted per account with its own term label.

marks.text: Each balance with the interest it will earn and the date of the last posting.

marks.label: Reversed line
marks.text: Greyed out with a Reversed badge; the original stays on record.

marks.label: Reversing entry
marks.text: The correcting line, with the reason.

marks.label: Reverse
marks.text: On every receipt line that can still be corrected (Bookkeeper).

marks.label: What will happen
marks.text: A reversing entry is added; the original stays on record.

marks.label: Reason (required)
marks.text: Why the entry is reversed (3 to 200 characters).

marks.label: Reverse entry
marks.text: Confirms the reversal; the cash returns to the box that day.

marks.label: Latest receipt
marks.text: Only the newest posted receipt of a loan can be voided.

marks.label: Void
marks.text: Bookkeeper only; a reason is asked.

marks.label: What will happen
marks.text: The installments and balance are restored; the receipt stays on record marked VOID.

marks.label: Reason (required)
marks.text: Why the receipt is voided.

marks.label: Void receipt
marks.text: Confirms the void.

marks.label: Marked VOID
marks.text: The voided receipt stays on record with its reason.

marks.label: Due again
marks.text: The balance and the amount due are back to what they were before the voided payment.

marks.label: Closed
marks.text: A closed account accepts no transactions.

marks.label: Reopen account
marks.text: Manager or Bookkeeper, for example when a resigned member returns.

marks.text: Pick the day to balance, then click Show.

marks.label: Receipts by type
marks.text: Every posted receipt of the day grouped by type, with counts and totals.

marks.label: Savings reversal
marks.text: A reversal books the cash back on the day it returned.

marks.text: Cash in minus cash out: the number that must match the counted cash.

marks.text: Movements and balances for savings and share capital.
